description: Shares feedback about Nock with the Nock team: product feedback from the user (praise, a complaint, something missing) or something concrete observed in Nock that worked or failed (a tool returned wrong or empty data, a step was confusing, a result was great). Not for model behavior, the user's local environment, an unclear prompt, or a tool error that was recovered from. actor "human" is for the user's own words; "agent" for the client's observations. message and context are in the user's language. Free, no credits. Not a support channel: no ticket and no reply.

actor.description: "human" when the feedback is the user's own words; "agent" (default) for your own observation.

context.description: What the user was trying to accomplish. Leave out sensitive business information, contact data, API keys and passwords.

feature_area.description: The Nock area it is about: search (busca de pessoas e empresas), enrichment (enriquecimento), signals (sinais), campaigns (campanhas e cadências), inbox (caixa de entrada), sheets (planilhas), integrations (integrações e CRM), agent (o Agente da Nock), mcp_api (MCP e API), billing (cobrança e créditos), other.

message.description: What broke or worked, concrete and specific: the tool or screen, what was expected, what happened.

name: send_feedback
title: Enviar feedback para a Nock
